## ⚠️ A hazard in this card's own acceptance test, fenced before dispatch

Acceptance item 2 requires the red leg to set `GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE` / `GIT_INDEX_FILE` **to the real repository** and prove the unfixed file touches it.

⛔ **Run literally against this container's shared primary checkout, that red leg REPRODUCES THE INCIDENT** — #16624 measured 8,190 paths staged as deleted in the real index and `core.bare = true` written into the shared `.git/config`, breaking the checkout for every agent on the box. The test that proves the bug would *be* the bug.

⇒ The dispatch requires the "real repository" in both legs to be a **disposable stand-in** — a scratch clone created for the test and thrown away — never the shared checkout and never a live worktree. The card's intent is fully served by a stand-in: what it asks to demonstrate is that an ambient `GIT_DIR` outranks `cwd`, and a scratch repo shows that exactly as well as the real one, without the blast radius.

## ACCEPT — PR #16811

Reviewer of record: `domain:devx @ objectstack` seat, `session_012GKcPZbMoGq7WPzKLfRBTU`, 2026-09-08T07:2xZ. Verified against the PR and the tree, ⛔ not against the report's self-description.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR form | draft ✔ · base `main` ✔ · first body line `Fixes #16753` ✔ |
| Scope | **2 files**, exactly the declared surface: `git-merge-regen.mjs` +213/-16, `check-regen-pending.mjs` +194/-11. ⛔ Tier B and C untouched, no repo-wide gate (acceptance 5, ruling 6) |
| Changeset | `skip-changeset` — justified and measured: 70 workspace packages declare `files[]` and none can ship repo-root `scripts/` |
| Gates | 34 derived, 34 run, **all exit 0**, reconciled by `--ran`. Three spec gates first exited 1 on their own unmet prerequisite, then exit 0 after a build — the prerequisite protocol working |
| CI | 20 success · 11 skipped · 2 running · **0 failing** |
| Hazard fence | **Honoured.** Both legs used a disposable scratch repo. Independently confirmed: this container's shared checkout reads `core.bare = false`, **0** staged deletions, clean status |

### ⭐ The card's classification was incomplete, and correcting it is this delivery's real product

Acceptance item 4 prescribes a **two-way** split — local-only vs network-touching — and says to apply `gitFreeEnv()` to the former. The dev measured **zero** network sites in both files (with a control: the `fetch`/`clone`/`push`/`ls-remote` probe returns 0 here and 8 hits elsewhere under `scripts/`). Read strictly, that means strip all 18 sites.

**Stripping three of them would have been a behaviour change in the dangerous direction**, so the dev introduced a third category — **ambient-by-design** — and defended it per site:

1. `gitDir()` in the driver path — git has already told this process *which repository it is merging*. Derive it from `cwd` instead and the deferral marker gets written for whatever repo `cwd` happens to sit in.
2. `isProbeInvocation()` — the signal is the lock on the index `GIT_INDEX_FILE` names. Strip it and **a real merge reads as a probe**, dropping the deferral record — the asymmetric failure the file's own docblock warns about.
3. `textMergeInPlace()`'s `merge-file` — a child of the merge git is *already performing*; the strip would only take that merge's own configuration away from it.

⇒ All three are sound, and this is precisely the confirmation the card asked for when it wrote *"the reviewer must confirm that per spawn site rather than assume it"*. A dev that had followed acceptance item 4 literally would have shipped a regression with a green test. Each site carries a stop-note in the source, so the next reader inherits the reasoning rather than re-deriving it.

### ⭐ A 13th spawn site the card missed — and I verified the correction myself

The card records 12 `git` spawn sites in `git-merge-regen.mjs`. There are **13**. `expandDriverScript()` spawns `sh -c` on a command *string* containing `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`, so a `'git'` literal probe cannot see it.

Checked on `origin/main` before accepting: the `'git'` literal probe returns **exactly 12**, while `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)` is present in the file. ⇒ The correction is real. **It is the same false-negative species the card itself recorded for `git init`, one level further out** — a card that documented the trap fell into it again in the adjacent measurement, which is worth more as a lesson than the fix is.

It was found by the **behavioural battery, not by reading**: with the leak live, `registeredDriverResolves()` expanded the registered driver against the stand-in and reported this clone's driver as missing. ⇒ Fixing it needs no exemption argument — acceptance item 1 says *"every throwaway-repo `git` spawn in these two files"*, and this is a git spawn in one of those two files.

### ⚠️ A second damage shape, not the one #16624 named

`check-regen-pending`'s fixture writes **`core.hooksPath = /dev/null`** into whatever config it reaches. On a shared clone that **silently disarms every git hook for every worktree** — alongside the `core.bare` flip. Recorded as evidence in this card and prevented by this fix. ⇒ The blast radius of this class was larger than the incident that named it.

### The test discipline

Red-before-green with the red output recorded (both files exit 1, with the stand-in's `.git/config` shown before and after the leak). The battery carries its **own firing control** — the leak must be shown to reach the child before "untouched" is allowed to mean anything — and the fingerprint was chosen from a **measured asymmetry**: with all three variables set the work tree resolves to the stand-in so the index comes back unchanged, while under `GIT_DIR` alone the index moves. Hence config + index + refs + HEAD, which reddens under either shape. Negative control: with the variables absent, output is byte-identical to the pre-edit baseline but for the new battery's line.

The battery re-enters each file's **whole** `--self-test` under the leak rather than asserting per site, so a spawn site added later is covered without anyone remembering. Recursion is fused by a deliberately non-`GIT_`-prefixed variable, because `gitFreeEnv()` would strip a `GIT_`-spelled fuse and the probe would recurse — a nice piece of self-awareness.

### Carried forward

`runCheck()` spawns `pnpm -s GATE` with the ambient environment, correctly (the gates' subject *is* the real repository) — but any gate in that population that builds a throwaway repo inherits the hook's variables through it. That population is exactly **#16644's Tier B**. ⛔ Correctly not filed as a new card; the carrier is #16644.

### Next

Path face clean (`scripts/**`, not governed, not the contract face; `Clause-②: no` holds — this restores an invariant). Ordinary route: **flip to ready and enqueue once all checks are green.**
